name: Sauce Labs API
tagline: Cloud testing platform REST API for automated browser and mobile app tests
description: Sauce Labs provides REST APIs for managing automated browser, mobile, and visual tests on a cloud grid. Developers use it to launch sessions, query jobs, manage assets, and integrate CI pipelines with Sauce Labs infrastructure.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth with Sauce Labs username and access key (username:access_key). Access key available from User Settings after signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free trial available; concrete free-tier API request limits not clearly published as a permanent free plan
pricing.paid_plans: Usage-based and subscription plans for Live, Automated, Mobile, Visual, and Error Reporting products

use_cases: list recent Sauce Labs test jobs for a user
get status and metadata for a specific test job
download job assets like screenshots or videos
start or manage automated browser test sessions via WebDriver
query account concurrency and usage for CI capacity planning
